# teams_online_voicemail_policy (Resource)

Manages the OnlineVoicemailPolicy policy via New-CsOnlineVoicemailPolicy / Get-CsOnlineVoicemailPolicy / Set-CsOnlineVoicemailPolicy / Remove-CsOnlineVoicemailPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `enable_editing_call_answer_rules_setting` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableEditingCallAnswerRulesSetting parameter.
- `enable_transcription` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableTranscription parameter.
- `enable_transcription_profanity_masking` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableTranscriptionProfanityMasking parameter.
- `enable_transcription_translation` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableTranscriptionTranslation parameter.
- `enable_voicemail_triage` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableVoicemailTriage parameter.
- `maximum_recording_length` (String) Maps to the -MaximumRecordingLength parameter.
- `postamble_audio_file` (String) Maps to the -PostambleAudioFile parameter.
- `preamble_audio_file` (String) Maps to the -PreambleAudioFile parameter.
- `preamble_postamble_mandatory` (Boolean) Maps to the -PreamblePostambleMandatory parameter.
- `primary_system_prompt_language` (String) Maps to the -PrimarySystemPromptLanguage parameter.
- `secondary_system_prompt_language` (String) Maps to the -SecondarySystemPromptLanguage parameter.
- `share_data` (String) Maps to the -ShareData parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
